O.location: vertical color legend at lower right
O.content: The pale-yellow top of the gradient is adjacent to the inscriptions "High" and "100," while the dark-burgundy bottom is adjacent to "Low" and "0."

B.text: The map’s state fill colors encode the Hazard H risk index according to the adjacent vertical legend: pale yellow at the top corresponds to the printed High/100 end and dark burgundy at the bottom corresponds to the printed Low/0 end. If the priority hazard review list is intended to select the highest risk-index state among the offered options, select the option for the highest encoded state.
B.conditions: Applies if the state labels identify their filled map areas, the legend governs those fills, and priority review means choosing the highest Hazard H risk index among ME, OK, and TX.

O.content: The title reads "Risk Index of Hazard H in US States," and the legend is labeled only with "High," "Low," and numeric endpoints.

B.text: The chart establishes relative Hazard H risk-index encoding but does not itself state the program rule, threshold, or other criterion for adding a state to priority review. Without that task-to-action criterion, a selection cannot be established from the chart alone.
B.conditions: Applies if no external or supplied policy defines how the risk index determines priority-review inclusion.
